evals.prompt: El login devuelve 500 tras el deploy de ayer, encuentra la causa y arreglalo
evals.expected_output: Reproduccion, hipotesis validada, fix con regression test
expectations: The bug is reproduced before any fix (a failing command or test is shown first)
The root cause is stated in one line
The fix cites file:line and targets the cause, not the symptom
A regression test is added and shown to fail before the fix and pass after
The original repro no longer reproduces

evals.prompt: Flaky test en el pipeline: test_checkout pasa 1 de cada 3 veces
evals.expected_output: Causa raiz del flake con fix determinista y evidencia de 2+ corridas
expectations: The flake is reproduced with 2+ runs shown before the fix
The root cause of the flake is stated
The fix is deterministic and cites file:line
Evidence of 2+ runs after the fix is shown

evals.prompt: Memory leak en el worker de colas, crece 100MB por hora
evals.expected_output: Diagnostico con medicion antes/despues y test de regresion
expectations: The leak is measured before the fix (a before number is shown)
The leak is measured after the fix, with a before/after comparison
No drive-by refactors outside the bug's scope
